cohort: The study participants were 179 healthy women with term pregnancies undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Fetal glucose consumption correlated with birth weight and maternal-fetal glucose gradient, but not with maternal BMI or uteroplacental glucose uptake, and was inversely correlated with placental glucose consumption.
cross-section timing: At term pregnancy, during elective cesarean section.
birth_weight: Measured in the study and correlated with fetal glucose consumption.
